title: Graph Neural Assisted Actor-Critic for Latency-Efficient Edge Vision System
abstract: arXiv:2608.16142v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: UAV on-board vision systems are widely used for different activities, including monitoring in no-fly zones. In this case, the vision-equipped UAV streams a video to a ground server where an operator assists its activities. The latency of video transmission has a profound impact on the effectiveness of the operator assistance. However, most techniques available for video transmission still incur significant latency costs. In this paper, we propose a graph convolutional neural network-assisted (GCN-Assisted A2C) deep reinforcement learning (DRL) system model to find the optimal pixel-correlated area of a suspicious object. We combine the Lagrangian dual form with gradient descent to prevent lack of convergence and over- and under-penalization constraint violation during latency optimization. The proposed system model sends a sub-group pixel-correlated area of the frame from the UAV to the server rather than the transmission of the whole

translated_title: 图神经网络辅助的Actor-Critic用于低延迟边缘视觉系统
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.16142v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：无人机机载视觉系统广泛应用于各种活动，包括禁飞区监控。在这种情况下，配备视觉系统的无人机将视频流传输到地面服务器，操作员在该服务器上协助其活动。视频传输的延迟对操作员协助的有效性有深远影响。然而，大多数现有的视频传输技术仍会产生显著的延迟成本。在本文中，我们提出了一种图卷积神经网络辅助的深度强化学习系统模型（GCN辅助A2C），用于寻找可疑对象的最佳像素相关区域。我们将拉格朗日对偶形式与梯度下降相结合，以防止在延迟优化过程中出现收敛不足以及过度和不足惩罚的约束违反。所提出的系统模型从无人机向服务器发送帧的像素相关子区域，而不是传输整个帧。
tldr: 本文提出一种基于图卷积网络辅助的深度强化学习系统，通过传输帧的像素相关子区域而非整个帧，并结合拉格朗日对偶与梯度下降优化延迟，从而显著降低边缘视觉系统的视频传输延迟。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a graph convolutional network-assisted deep reinforcement learning system that transmits pixel-correlated sub-regions of frames instead of full frames, combined with Lagrangian dual and gradient descent to optimize latency, significantly reducing video transmission delay in edge vision systems.
